title: HLHB trend catcher on 15m: EMA5/10 cross with RSI(10) of median price through 50, ADX above 25, volume-confirmed

source.title: freqtrade-strategies: hlhb (HLHB Trend-Catcher, after Hucklekiwi Pip / BabyPips)

rule_summary: Chart 15m, closed bars; a signal at the close of bar t fills at the open of bar t+1 (price E). All indicators on 15m: EMA5 and EMA10 of close; RSI10 (Wilder) of the median price (high+low)/2; ADX14 (Wilder); Vmean(t) = mean volume of bars t-20..t-1. ENTRY at the close of t when ALL hold on the same bar: (1) EMA5 crosses above EMA10 (EMA5(t) > EMA10(t) and EMA5(t-1) <= EMA10(t-1)); (2) RSI10 crosses above 50 (RSI10(t) > 50 and RSI10(t-1) <= 50); (3) ADX14(t) > 25; (4) activity filter (b), fixed in advance: volume(t) >= 1.5 x Vmean(t); (5) flat. EXITS, first to occur: hard stop at E x 0.985 (intrabar); trailing stop: once the highest high since entry reaches E x 1.019, exit intrabar at 1.2% below the highest high since entry (values from the source); mirror signal (EMA5 crosses below EMA10 AND RSI10 crosses below 50 on the same bar) exits at the next open; time exit at the close of the 48th bar after entry (12 hours). One position per pair, no pyramiding, same numbers on all nine pairs. No daily or hourly inputs.
mechanism: The source gives no mechanism beyond 'catch short trends'. Closest honest one: a simultaneous fast-MA cross and RSI cross of 50 while ADX > 25 marks a bar where short-term momentum resumes inside an already strong directional move; with 1.5x volume the push is real order flow (split institutional orders persist for hours, per the order-flow persistence literature cited by Concretum), and the other side is mean-reversion liquidity providers and late stops. Cost: the 1.5% stop and the 1.9%-activated, 1.2%-wide trail make winners exit at >= +0.7% and typically +1.5-2.5%, losers at about -1.5% or earlier via the time exit; with a ~40-45% win rate on that payoff the average gross move is about 0.5%, above the 0.30% round trip.
